correctness.rationale: The backward two-orientation telegraph/killing ODE has matrix M_kappa with M_kappa²=kappa(alpha+kappa)/v² I; transferring through finite reactive layers with bounded exterior solutions gives R_i=A_i coth(B_i/v) and P_R(v;x,m)=[R_L+alpha(x+a)/v+m]/[R_L+R_R+2alpha a/v]. The centered-unbiased preference has sign R_L−R_R. Its log ratio is strictly monotone in t=1/v if B_L!=B_R, since B/sinh(2Bt) is strictly decreasing in B. Endpoint rankings depend respectively on kappa_i and kappa_i L_i, giving exactly one finite reversal iff (k_R−k_L)(k_R L_R−k_L L_L)<0; symmetric full degeneracy yields half at all v. Recurrent pre-killing motion plus positive hazard on repeated visits proves a.s. absorption. Independent 2×2 transfer-equation calculations checked 36 parameter cases and crossover ~2.216128237.
